result.topic_en: Riemann evaluates integrals of logarithms of elliptic modular quantities (k, k', K) along the path from 0 to e^{xi} as series involving log tan, log 4 cos/sin, and fractional-part (bracket) terms, and examines their imaginary/real parts at rational values of x/2π.

63. $\int_0^{e^{xi}}-\log k'\,\frac{dq}{q}=-2\log\lg\frac{x}{2}^2-\frac29\log\lg\frac{3x}{2}^2-\frac2{25}\log\lg\frac{5x}{2}^2-\dots$
$+4\pi i\left\{\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}\right)-\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac12\right)\right\}+\frac{4\pi i}{9}\left\{\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}\right)-\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}+\frac12\right)\right\}+\frac{4\pi i}{25}\left\{\left(\frac{5x}{2\pi}\right)-\left(\frac{5x}{2\pi}+\frac12\right)\right\}$
[Cujus pars realis ita quoque [-et-] exhiberi potest, designando, ut supra, $p$ numerum imparem]
$=-\sum_{-\infty,\infty}\frac{\log\lg\frac{px}{2}^2}{p^2}$
64. $\int_0^{e^{xi}}\log\frac{2K}{\pi}\frac{dq}{q}=2\log 4\cos\frac{x}{2}^2+\frac29\log4\cos\frac{3x}{2}^2+\dots=\sum_{-\infty,\infty}\frac{\log 4\cos\frac{px}{2}^2}{p^2}$
$+4\pi i\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}\right)+\frac{4\pi i}{9}\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}\right)+\frac{4\pi i}{25}\left(\frac{5x}{2\pi}\right)+\dots$
65.) $\int_0^{e^{xi}}\left(\frac{2K}{\pi}-1\right)\frac{dq}{q}=-2\log4\sin\frac{x}{2}^2+\frac23\log4\sin\frac{3x}{2}^2-\frac25\log4\sin\frac{5x}{2}^2+\dots$
$-4\pi i\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac12\right)+\frac{4\pi i}{3}\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}+\frac12\right)-\dots$
$=i\log\lg\left(\frac{2x+\pi}{4}\right)^2+\frac{i}{2}\log\lg\left(\frac{4x+\pi}{4}\right)^2+\frac{i}{3}\log\lg\left(\frac{6x+\pi}{4}\right)^2+\dots+\frac{2\pi}{3}\left(\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)+\dots$
$+2\pi\left(\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)+\frac{2\pi}{2}\left(\left(\frac{2x}{2\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{2x}{2\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)$
66.) $\int_0^{e^{xi}}\frac{2k K}{\pi}\frac{dq}{q}=-2\log\lg\frac{x}{4}^2+\frac23\log\lg\frac{3x}{4}^2-\frac25\log\lg\frac{5x}{4}^2+\dots$
$+4\pi i\left(\left(\frac{x}{4\pi}\right)-\left(\frac{x}{4\pi}+\frac12\right)\right)-\frac{4\pi i}{3}\left(\left(\frac{3x}{4\pi}\right)-\left(\frac{3x}{4\pi}+\frac12\right)\right)+\frac{4\pi i}{5}\left(\left(\frac{5x}{4\pi}\right)-\left(\frac{5x}{4\pi}+\frac12\right)\right)$
$=2i\log\lg\left(\frac{x+\pi}{4}\right)^2+\frac{2i}{3}\log\lg\left(\frac{3x+\pi}{4}\right)^2+\frac{2i}{5}\log\lg\left(\frac{5x+\pi}{4}\right)^2+\dots$
$+4\pi\left(\left(\frac{x}{4\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{x}{4\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)+\frac{4\pi}{3}\left(\left(\frac{3x}{4\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{3x}{4\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)+\dots$
67.) $\int_0^{e^{xi}}\left(\frac{2k'K}{\pi}-1\right)\frac{dq}{q}=-2\log4\cos\frac{x}{2}^2+\frac23\log4\cos\frac{3x}{2}^2-\frac25\log4\cos\frac{5x}{2}^2+\dots$
$-4\pi i\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}\right)+\frac{4\pi i}{3}\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}\right)-\frac{4\pi i}{5}\left(\frac{5x}{2\pi}\right)+\dots$
$=-i\log\lg\left(\frac{2x+\pi}{4}\right)^2+\frac{i}{2}\log\lg\left(\frac{4x+\pi}{4}\right)^2-\frac{i}{3}\log\lg\left(\frac{6x+\pi}{4}\right)^2+\dots$
$-2\pi\left(\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)+\frac{2\pi}{2}\left(\left(\frac{2x}{2\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{2x}{2\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)-\dots$
68. $\int_0^{e^{xi}}\left(\frac{2\sqrt{k'}K}{\pi}-1\right)\frac{dq}{q}=-\log4\cos x^2+\frac13\log4\cos3x^2-\frac15\log4\cos5x^2+\dots$
$-2\pi i\left(\frac{x}{\pi}\right)+\frac{2\pi i}{3}\left(\frac{3x}{\pi}\right)-\frac{2\pi i}{5}\left(\frac{5x}{\pi}\right)+\dots$
$=-\frac{i}{2}\log\lg\left(x+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)^2+\frac{i}{4}\log\lg\left(2x+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)^2-\frac{i}{6}\log\lg\left(3x+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)^2+\dots$
$-\pi\left(\left(\frac{x}{\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{x}{\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)+\frac{\pi}{2}\left(\left(\frac{2x}{\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{2x}{\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)-\frac{\pi}{3}\left(\left(\frac{3x}{\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{3x}{\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)+\dots$
